description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Connecticut General Statutes — Connecticut state law — by citation. "Conn. Gen. Stat. 53a-54a" is murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does Connecticut General Statutes 53a-54a say" or to check a CT statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "53a-54a" (murder) or "14-227a" (DUI). The part before the dash is the title.

name: ct_general_statute
